events.title: Two Hellenistic Cities: Alexandria and Pergamon
events.description: An engaging public lecture exploring the cultural and historical significance of the ancient cities of Alexandria and Pergamon. This event provides an intellectual dive into history for local residents interested in ancient civilizations.

events.title: Acting Up!'s Season of Four One Act Plays
events.description: A showcase of four distinct one-act plays hosted by the local Lind Theatre community, offering an intimate experience of experimental and fringe-style dramatic performances.

events.title: Human Factors and Systems Science Symposium
events.description: A symposium focused on human factors and systems science, bringing together researchers and thinkers to discuss complex systems, technology, and design.

events.title: SUNSHINE COAST – Australian Poetry Slam Heat
events.description: A high-energy poetry slam competition where local writers and performers share their original works, fostering a creative and community-focused atmosphere.
